# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Always add or update Jest unit tests for any new features or behavior changes in this repository.
- Always run a syntax check on any modified JavaScript using the project's test runner (`npm test`, which fails on syntax errors) or `node --check <file>` for quick file checks before completing work.
- Always run `npm test` to execute the unit test suite before finishing a pull request, even if the change seems minor.
